use_case_label: Respond to an EU public consultation
selector_note: Use the formal consultation template when the task is an open portal or Have Your Say submission rather than a private complaint.
not_for: Private enforcement complaints or outreach emails.

selector_note: Start with the FOI template when the goal is access to documents from an EU institution under Regulation 1049/2001.
not_for: National FOI systems unless separately adapted.

use_case_label: Complain to the European Ombudsman about maladministration
selector_note: Use only when the target is an EU institution or body and direct contact has already happened.
not_for: National authorities; local ombudsmen; private-company disputes.

use_case_label: Challenge a platform suspension or removal
selector_note: Start with the platform review email; only move to political outreach if the issue becomes systemic or process-driven.
not_for: Formal ombudsman complaints as a first move.

use_case_label: Follow up on illegal content or a failed notice-and-action path
selector_note: Use the issue email first to preserve the platform chronology; escalate politically only if there is a broader DSA process angle.
not_for: Journalist outreach before the platform route is documented.

use_case_label: Complain about dark patterns or manipulative design
selector_note: Use the citizen complaint email for first contact; use the NGO route if the pattern looks systemic or repeatable.
not_for: DPA silence follow-up where no DPA complaint exists yet.

use_case_label: Make or repeat a controller-side GDPR rights request
selector_note: Use the controller-facing GDPR email first; escalate to a privacy NGO only when the issue looks broader than one unresolved personal request.
not_for: DPA follow-up or MEP pressure before the controller route is documented.

use_case_label: Follow up after DPA silence on a GDPR complaint
selector_note: Use the DPA follow-up first; use the MEP template if the issue has become one of systemic under-enforcement.

use_case_label: Ask a privacy NGO to review or amplify a systemic GDPR issue
selector_note: Use the NGO support email when the aim is validation; support; or amplification rather than direct legal representation.
not_for: Basic personal disputes with no systemic or cross-border signal.

use_case_label: Pitch a journalist on GDPR under-enforcement
selector_note: Prefer the GDPR-specific journalist pitch when the public-interest story is about enforcement delay or systemic privacy failure.
not_for: Thinly evidenced or purely personal disputes.

use_case_label: Coordinate several complainants or allies before a cross-border GDPR escalation
selector_note: Use the coordination note when several people need a common chronology or shared framing before external escalation.

use_case_label: Raise a procedural concern with an MEP on a live policy file
selector_note: Use the MEP outreach template for ordinary political contact; use the coordinator version when internal committee leverage matters.
not_for: Formal filings to authorities or ombudsmen.

use_case_label: Pressure a committee coordinator on process; pace; or stakeholder balance
selector_note: Use the coordinator template when the recipient's role inside committee management is the reason for contacting them.
not_for: Generic constituent outreach where no coordinator role matters.

selector_note: Use the Commission process email when the consultation design itself is the grievance.
not_for: Private complaints to platforms or traders.

use_case_label: Pitch a journalist on a public-interest issue that is not specifically GDPR under-enforcement
selector_note: Use the general journalist pitch when the repo issue has public-interest value but is not yet a regulator-delay story.
not_for: Controller-side rights requests or platform support tickets.

use_case_label: Ask an NGO or network to review or amplify a concern
selector_note: Use the NGO support email when you want review; coalition; or amplification rather than public media attention first.

use_case_label: Report an accessibility failure to the service owner first
selector_note: Use the accessibility template for the first remediation ask and chronology.
not_for: European Ombudsman complaints against national public bodies without exhausting the right route.

use_case_label: Send a first documented complaint on a cross-border consumer dispute
selector_note: Use the consumer dispute email for the trader or platform first; escalate externally only once the facts are documented.
